title: ProjectKongorEvidenceDossier
description: Standardized schema for reverse-engineered K2 engine functions and structures to enable clean-room reimplementation and sub-second offline verification.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the dossier format specification.

status.description: Workflow lifecycle state. CI only mandates cleanroom tests for 'reimplemented', 'verified', and 'satisfied' states.

authority_scope.description: Runtime authority domain for obligation and triangulation verification.

title.description: Human-readable title describing the function or mechanic.

base_address.description: Ghidra or image base address in hex (e.g. '0x180000000').

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the target binary for deterministic provenance.

signature_mask.description: IDA-style hex pattern with ?? wildcards for resilient SigScan matching across patches.

symbol_name.description: Original or reconstructed symbol name (e.g. 'FUN_180035d40' or 'CGame::ProcessPacket').

class_name.description: Owning class name if this is a member method.

vtable_index.description: Zero-based index in the virtual method table (VTable slot), or null if non-virtual.

decompiled_c.description: Canonical decompiled pseudo-C code extracted from Ghidra.

hexrays_c.description: Optional IDA Pro 9.0 Hex-Rays decompiled C output for Dual-Oracle contradiction auditing (Option V).

branch_annotations.description: Branch-to-RVA coverage ledger (Option G / Option O).

callees.description: Addresses or symbols called by this function.

callers.description: Known call sites and xrefs into this function.

referenced_strings.description: Literal strings referenced in this function's scope.

struct_offsets.description: Key-value mapping of struct member offsets to member names (e.g. {'0x18': 'm_uiHealth'}).

global_mutations.description: Global singletons or memory regions mutated (e.g. 'g_EntityInventory', 'g_pSystem').

source_file.description: Path to clean-room implementation source file (e.g. 'src/libs/protocol-core/PacketParser.cs').

symbol_name.description: Name of the reimplemented class or method.

test_file.description: Path to unit test file validating the clean-room reimplementation.

notes.description: Analysis notes, algorithmic observations, or reverse-engineering context.

capstone_prologue_analysis.description: Static Capstone x86_64 prologue sizing, RIP-relative hazard, and register/group analysis.

limitations_and_unknowns.description: Static vs dynamic triangulation unknowns ledger (Evidence Dossier v2).
